semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing photoresists and auxiliary chemicals specifically for semiconductor and flat panel display fabrication.
summary: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. (TOK) is a leading manufacturer of photoresists and auxiliary chemicals for the semiconductor industry, providing a comprehensive range of products for both front-end and packaging processes. With a strong focus on R&D and advanced manufacturing technologies, TOK supports the evolution of semiconductor fabrication through high-purity chemical solutions.
capabilities: Manufacturing of photoresists for advanced semiconductor processes (g/i/KrF/ArF/EUV)
Development of photosensitive permanent films for MEMS applications
Production of high purity chemicals for photolithography

regional_presence.Japan: TOK has R&D facilities and manufacturing plants in Japan, ensuring stable production of state-of-the-art photoresists.
regional_presence.Korea: The company also operates a manufacturing plant in Korea to support its production capabilities.
regional_presence.United States: TOK has a sales and support network extending to the United States.
regional_presence.Europe: The company maintains a presence in Europe as part of its global sales and support strategy.
regional_presence.Asia: TOK has a significant presence in Asia, including markets in Taiwan and China.
